heading.title: Duties of Appropriate Government, Local Authority and Parents

article.title: Duty of appropriate Government and local authority to establish school.
article.content:
6Duty of appropriate Government and local authority to establish school.

Section 6  ·  Chapter III  ·  page 5 of the Act
For carrying out the provisions of this Act, the appropriate Government and the local authority shall establish, within such area or limits of neighbourhood, as may be prescribed, a school, where it is not so established, within a period of three years from the commencement of this Act.
